item.title: Recently planted tree has snapped and needs replacing., 16th July
item.description:
The damaged tree is located on the green space between Farmfield Road and Japonica Drive. Exact coordinates: 51.87943° N, 2.09959° W The tree appears to have either been vandalised or damaged by strong winds and has snapped close to the base. It is now lying across the grass and does not appear capable of recovery. As this seems to be a recently planted tree, please could it be removed and replaced with a new one.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 11, Japonica Drive, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
